# scripts/Showcase/ShowCamera.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/ShowCamera.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Showcase camera modes: FREE fly controls, FOLLOW actor orbit, and DIRECTOR via CineEditor.
Uses TimeFx real time. Fly/look input takes control; C returns to director.
Right mouse looks/orbits, wheel changes speed/distance, Tab cycles actors, and clicking selects a subject.

Base: `Camera3D`. Registered class: `none`.
